```ts
}>;
```

What one generation bills: whole images, or seconds of video.

### MediaMetering

```ts
type MediaMetering = Readonly<{
  admit: (input) => Promise<
    Readonly<{
      priceMilliunits: number;
    }>
  >;
  settle: (input) => Promise<void>;
}>;
```

The host's billing owner for Media. Every call is keyed by the durable operation
id and must be idempotent: a lost acknowledgement is retried with the same id
and must never admit, hold, or charge twice.

---

### MediaServiceHost

```ts
type MediaServiceHost = Readonly<{
  scope: MediaScope;

     getByName: MediaOperation;
  };

  beforeAdmit?: (requestId) => Promise<void>;
  authorizeGeneration?: () => Promise<void>;
  destination: Readonly<{
     authorize: (path) => Promise<void>;

     readReference?: (reference) => Promise<MediaReferenceBytes>;

}> &
  | Readonly<{
  metering: "unmetered";

}>;
```

Host authority, durable operations, provider, metering and destination access.

```ts
type MediaGenerationOutcome =

      height: number;
      model: string;
      width: number;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "pending";
      background: boolean;
      retryAfterSeconds: number;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "conflict";
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "interrupted";
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "unavailable";
    }>;
```

The typed result of one generation, shared by the Hono route and the Agent path.
